analysis.session_summary: The tape was dominated by suspected yen intervention that lifted JPY 0.518% to its best close and drove USD/JPY down 50.2 pips. The dollar still rose 0.205% overall despite a soft PPI print (0.3% vs 0.4%) that triggered only a 0.062% USD dip. Risk-sensitive currencies lagged, with AUD the weakest major at -0.428% and VIX up 3.4%. Most intraday legs had no clear catalyst, indicating flow-driven and intervention-led trade.

themes.theme: Suspected yen intervention drives JPY outperformance
themes.evidence: High-impact 'Suspected Yen Intervention' at 19:00, USD/JPY -50.2 pips, JPY strength +0.518% closed at best.
PPI 0.3% vs 0.4% forecast produced only -0.062% USD impulse; DXY gained 0.208%.

currency_drivers.USD: Soft PPI miss initially weakened USD, but DXY still rose 0.208% on broad flow.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own catalyst; euro slipped 0.142% with no major release to explain it.
currency_drivers.JPY: Suspected intervention drove JPY to a 0.518% gain and closed at its best.
currency_drivers.GBP: No catalyst; sterling added only 0.052% in quiet trade.
currency_drivers.AUD: No direct catalyst; weakest major on risk aversion, down 0.428%.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases; CAD edged up 0.108% with no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.CHF: No clear catalyst; CHF fell 0.147% despite risk-off VIX rise.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own catalyst; kiwi fell 0.167% amid broad commodity/FX softness.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: An early 9.6-pip flow bounce gave way to a 46.7-pip slide on no clear catalyst, leaving EUR/USD down 38.2 pips.

polarity_reads.read: PPI miss produced only a 0.062% USD impulse but larger rallies in AUD/USD, GBP/USD and gold, suggesting the market was already positioned for a soft print and covered USD shorts.

scenarios.name: Intervention extends risk-off
scenarios.thesis: Suspected BoJ action continues, keeping JPY bid and pressuring high-beta FX.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recovers the 50.2-pip intervention drop and intervention headlines stop.

scenarios.name: USD rebound after PPI fade
scenarios.thesis: PPI-induced USD weakness proves temporary; dollar regains ground as intervention impulse fades.

pair_paths.rationale: Echoes today's 29.3-pip USD/CHF advance as USD recovers.

scenarios.name: Choppy consolidation
scenarios.thesis: Markets await CAD CPI and Fed Warsh; majors stay range-bound, intervention risk caps USD/JPY.
scenarios.invalidation: A high-impact surprise or renewed intervention breaks ranges.

risks.why_it_matters: Could drive USD/JPY sharply lower and spill into yen crosses.
Could reverse PPI-induced USD dip and lift DXY.
Could move USD/CAD and CAD crosses.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: High-impact CAD CPI at 14:30 (0.3% m/m expected) and Fed Chairman Warsh Speaks at 18:00 are the main catalysts that can break the current ranges.
